Evos Deal Leaves Credit Profile Stable
: S&P expects Adani Ports’ Evos acquisition to leave its credit profile largely unchanged. Debt-to-EBITDA is forecast at 2.3x in FY28 and 2.7x in FY29, below the 3.5x downside threshold.
: Adani Ports is competing for a ₹11,733-crore Outer Harbour project at V O Chidambaranar Port in Thoothukudi. The port infrastructure contract will use the Hybrid Annuity Model.
: ADANIPORTS’ average 12-month price target rose to INR 2,131.12 from INR 2,116.12, implying about 10% upside from its Nov. 9 close. Analysts’ ratings: 23 Buy, no Hold and one Sell.
